tour.name: Algarve Private Tour: Benagil Cave by Boat, Ponta da Piedade, Lagos & Sagres
tour.subtitle: The golden cliffs of the Algarve in one private day with a licensed guide and vehicle: a boat to the Benagil sea cave and its sunlit dome, the clifftop walk of the Seven Hanging Valleys, the rock arches of Ponta da Piedade, the old town of Lagos and the fortress of Sagres at the end of Europe.

tour.overview:
Portugal's southern coast, the Algarve, is famous for its golden limestone cliffs, carved by the sea into arches, stacks and caves. The most famous is the Benagil cave, a great sea cave whose dome has a hole open to the sky, lighting a hidden beach. In the west, the cliffs of Ponta da Piedade and the windswept capes of Sagres and St Vincent mark the end of Europe, where Henry the Navigator is said to have planned the voyages of discovery.

This private day takes you along the coast with a licensed guide and a vehicle, with a boat trip to the caves.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 9 hours
• Start and end: your hotel in the Algarve
• Type: private tour with licensed guide, vehicle and driver; boat trip
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy to moderate

WHAT YOU SEE
• The Benagil cave.
• The Seven Hanging Valleys trail.
• Ponta da Piedade.
• Lagos.
• Sagres and Cape St Vincent.

WHY THIS WORKS
A private vehicle links the central and western Algarve, and your guide times the boat trip to the calmest sea.

WHO IT SUITS
Families, couples, walkers and photographers.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For culture, ask us about Silves, Tavira or the Ria Formosa lagoon.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Landing on the beach inside the Benagil cave is not allowed; boats enter the cave. Boat trips depend on the sea.

days.name: The Benagil cave, the Seven Hanging Valleys, Ponta da Piedade, Lagos and Sagres
days.description:
What to expect: the cliffs, caves and capes of the Algarve, with a licensed guide, private vehicle and boat trips.

Your guide and driver collect you at about 8:30. At Benagil, a small boat takes you along the cliffs into the great sea cave, where sunlight falls through the dome onto a golden beach, and to other grottoes and arches nearby. You then walk part of the Seven Hanging Valleys trail, a clifftop path with views down to Marinha beach, often called one of the most beautiful in Europe.

You drive west to Lagos, a port from which caravels sailed to Africa in the 15th century, and walk its old town of white houses, the Church of Santo António, with its gilded wooden interior, and the waterfront. After lunch (not included), you visit Ponta da Piedade, where steps lead down the cliffs to arches and stacks of golden rock; in season, a small boat or kayak takes you through the grottoes.

You end at Sagres, with its fortress and wind compass, and Cape St Vincent, the south-western tip of Europe, where the lighthouse stands above cliffs 75 metres high, for the sunset before driving back.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:30 – Pick-up at your hotel.
09:30 – Boat to the Benagil cave.
11:00 – Seven Hanging Valleys trail.
12:30 – Lagos and lunch.
14:30 – Ponta da Piedade.
16:00 – Sagres fortress.
Sunset – Cape St Vincent.
20:00 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Stand-up paddle or kayak to Benagil can replace the boat for the adventurous.
• Bring swimwear for a beach stop.
• The sea is calmest in the morning.

INCLUDED: private vehicle and driver, licensed guide, boat trips, bottled water, hotel pick-up and drop-off.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: none.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Can we land in the Benagil cave?
faq.answer: No. Landing has been banned for safety; boats and kayaks enter the cave.

faq.question: What if the sea is rough?
faq.answer: If boats cannot go out, we visit the caves from the clifftops and adapt the day.

faq.question: Is lunch included?
faq.answer: No. Your guide suggests a seafood restaurant in Lagos.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Child seats and life vests are provided.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Partly. The clifftop viewpoints are accessible; the Ponta da Piedade steps are not.

faq.question: Can we swim?
faq.answer: Yes, at a beach stop in summer.

faq.question: Can we kayak instead?
faq.answer: Yes, with a local operator, on request.

faq.question: Will we be taken to shops?
faq.answer: No. There are no commission stops.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Light clothes, swimwear, sun protection and shoes for the cliffs.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: April to October; spring and autumn are quieter.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is not obligatory in Portugal, but rounding up or leaving 5 to 10 percent for a guide or driver you were happy with is appreciated.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
